description: glossaries.categories.create and glossaries.terms.create take the glossary to create in as the path `parent`, and the new category or term as the body. The body has its own Required `parent`: "The immediate parent of the GlossaryCategory in the resource-hierarchy. It can either be a Glossary or a GlossaryCategory". Flattening the body into the input gave both the same member name, and the path parameter won, so a category or term could not be created under a category. This patch renames the path member to `glossary`.
